doc: Every reason public/ops/checks.json can carry (scripts/master/checks.mjs REASONS), what it means and who fixes it. Read by the Operations dashboard. No sheet id or sheet URL.

changes.reason: editing: lessons waiting to be cut
changes.change: CHANGE for Operations: new reason, and fewer "no file link" items. A lesson row the team marks editing_status = "in editing" while it has no file link is no longer a "no file link" item; instead each course gets ONE summary item "editing: lessons waiting to be cut" with the count in detail. When the file link is added the status is ignored and the lesson goes the normal way (conversion, pre-check, release).

CHANGE for Operations: new reason. The weekly media-playcheck (and a manual run) found a LIVE file (approved, on media.84000.digital) that does not play: not HTTP 200, wrong content type, size not the manifest size, decode errors, duration off by more than 2 %, or for video moov box after mdat (not faststart) or no poster. detail names the cause. The lesson is still shown in the app; it needs a person: re-convert it (check_decision fixed after the file is replaced) or hold it.

reasons.meaning: the converted file is shorter than 5 minutes
reasons.fix: listen; approve anyway, hold, or replace the file and set fixed

reasons.meaning: the converted file is longer than 4 hours
reasons.fix: listen; approve anyway, hold, or replace the file and set fixed

reasons.reason: duration differs > 2 % from the Drive source
reasons.meaning: the conversion is not as long as the Drive file
reasons.fix: listen; replace the file and set fixed, or approve anyway

reasons.meaning: the Drive file's duration could not be read
two lessons have the very same recording
reasons.fix: fix the link of the wrong lesson and set fixed

reasons.reason: silence > 60 s in the first 2 min
reasons.fix: listen; approve anyway or replace the file

reasons.reason: silence > 60 s in the last 2 min
reasons.fix: listen; approve anyway or replace the file

reasons.meaning: the converted video is not as long as its source
reasons.fix: watch; replace the file and set fixed, or approve anyway

reasons.meaning: two lessons have the very same video
reasons.fix: fix the link of the wrong lesson and set fixed

reasons.reason: same source file as another Drive id
reasons.meaning: two Drive ids point at the same file
reasons.fix: fix the link of the wrong lesson and set fixed

reasons.meaning: the file could not reach the audio standard (detail: the measured reason)
reasons.fix: replace the recording and set fixed, or hold

reasons.meaning: Drive refused the file (HTTP 403/404): not shared with the service account, deleted or in the trash
reasons.fix: share the file with the service account (or restore it), then set fixed

reasons.meaning: the lesson row has no Drive file link (or only a folder link)
reasons.fix: add the file link in mp3_link, mp4_link or minicourse_link, then set fixed

reasons.meaning: the course has no approved lesson and nothing is waiting for the pipeline
reasons.fix: fix the lessons listed in detail

reasons.reason: editing: lessons waiting to be cut
reasons.meaning: lessons of this course marked "in editing" with no file link yet (count in detail); a summary, one per course
reasons.fix: nothing until the cut file exists; then add its link in the sheet

reasons.meaning: a live file failed the playback check (detail: http, content-type, size, decode, duration, not faststart or poster)
reasons.fix: replace or re-convert the file and set fixed, or hold
